reporting_basis: SOLO / STANDALONE. Determined 2026-08-26 by matching the total assets this dataset records against the balance sheets in the bank's own annual report. Evidence: FY2025 total assets of 589,486.81m match the figure under this report's 'Balance Sheet' (solo) heading; the larger 591,933m figure in the document is the consolidated total.
notes: Very deep IR archive: ~74 quarterly/half-yearly PDFs found spanning back to 2010. As of 2026-08-26, 36 distinct quarters have been extracted and validated: 2026 Q1-Q2 (prior session) plus a deepening pass this session covering 2014 Q1-Q3, 2015 Q1-Q2, 2016 Q1-Q3, 2017 Q1-Q3, 2018 Q1 & Q3, 2019-2025 Q1-Q3 (complete for every year 2016-2025 except 2018 Q2). Remaining genuine gaps: 2010-2013 (entirely - dead links on the live site AND on Wayback Machine playback, confirmed across 2 retry rounds), 2015 Q3, and 2018 Q2 (same dead-link-both-places pattern) - see the 'found_not_yet_extracted' entry below for detail. These are not fabricated or annual-backfilled; they are recorded as gaps for a future session to re-attempt.

sources.note: 2026-08-26 deepening pass extracted 32 of the ~34 additional quarters attempted (see the 2014_Q1 through 2025_Q3 entries above), leaving these genuinely blocked: (1) 2010-2013 (Q1 Y 2011/2012, Q3 Y 2010/2011/2012, Half Y 2011/2012, 1st_Quarter_Financial_Position_2013, 3rd_qt_statements_2013, half_yearly_financial_position_2013_new) - every one of these URLs 404s on the live bankasia-bd.com site; the Wayback Machine's CDX API lists captures for all of them (e.g. 1st_Quarter_Financial_Position_2013.pdf at 20220322061231) but the playback layer (web.archive.org/web/<ts>id_/...) returned 404 for every one tried (Q1 Y 2011, Details_BA_FS_Q2_2018, ba_3rd_Quarter_Financial_Report_2015, 1st_Quarter_Financial_Position_2013 - 4 distinct URLs across 2 retry rounds, both after an initial 'Internet Archive services are temporarily offline' banner had cleared), so this is a genuine, repeatedly-confirmed access blocker, not a transient blip. (2) 2018 Q2 (Details_BA_FS_Q2_2018_Aug_07_2018.pdf, Financial Statement_30_07_2018.pdf) - both candidate URLs 404 live and both Wayback captures also 404 on playback. (3) 2015 Q3 (ba_3rd_Quarter_Financial_Report_2015.pdf) - same pattern, 404 live and on Wayback playback. None of these were fabricated or backfilled from annual data - they are recorded as gaps. Worth re-attempting in a future session in case the Wayback playback issue is transient after all, despite surviving 2 retry rounds in this session.
